text:
Clara Nguyen: Kickoff: Atlas Retail onboarding target Mon 2026-04-20. Need final stakeholder roster, clear 14-day success criteria, owners for infra/enablement/billing, and any renewal/procurement flags to track. @Ben Ortiz @Maya Singh @Kunal Shah

Ben Ortiz: Intake list: Priya V. (Product), Omar H. (Infra), Jess C. (Data). Finance contact Jeff L. pending. CSM flagged a procurement review ~40d out - mark as medium risk.

Maya Singh: I can run enablement (35-45m). Plan: 20m product walkthrough, 15m integration patterns, 10m Q&A + quick troubleshooting. Will post agenda and poll times by EOD. Mornings preferred for Product. :spiral_calendar:

Kunal Shah: I'll own tech onboarding: env prep, API keys, sample ingestion, and smoke tests. Need network contact for Private deployment (firewall/IP allowlist). I'll share a pre-onboard checklist tomorrow.

Clara Nguyen: Proposed 14-day success (draft): 1) Staging E2E smoke with median gen latency <200ms; 2) 8-12 representative prompts meet quality gate (<=5% failure); 3) Console access provisioned for 3 engineers and they can run quick test; 4) Billing baseline & first-cost estimate shared. Add model pin to rw-v1.3 and require data handling signoff for any PII.

Ben Ortiz: +1. Also add a renewal signal row: budget/procurement windows, exec engagement, and `usage < threshold` alerts.

Maya Singh: I'll collect enablement feedback via a 3-question form and paste results into the playbook. Will include one actionable ask per attendee.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Atlas - Enablement" Thu 2026-04-23 17:00 UTC  https://calendar.example/evt/atlas-101

Kunal Shah: Pre-checklist draft: - create service account + API key - provide IP allowlist entries - upload sample payloads/schema - grant console access to 3 engineers - share test prompt set in shared drive

Quick sanity curl for devs:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"<smoke test>","max_tokens":64}'
```

Clara Nguyen: Who will own the 14-day health summary (KPIs, blockers, renewal flags)? Need a one-pager and a 15-min readout on day 14.

Ben Ortiz: I'll own the health summary. I'll include KPIs (p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, quality pass %, integration blockers), renewal signals, and recommended mitigations. Draft ready by day 12.

Maya Singh: I'll synthesize enablement feedback and add notes to the onboarding playbook.

Clara Nguyen: Great. I'll add the 40-day procurement review to Renewal Signals as medium risk and note mitigations (exec sponsor intro, usage highlights, adoption roadmap). Cadence: enablement Thu, quick go/no-go Fri. :thumbsup:
